history.summary: Large 4BR (1335sqft) at Sea Horizon, a 2017 99yr (privatised EC) in Pasir Ris D18, at $1.749M / $1,310 PSF — the lowest PSF in its bracket and sitting in the liquid sub-$1.8M band. Strong arena record (238-179, Elo 1350) but no URA project data and no MRT walkability captured.
history.rating_rationale: $1,310 PSF for a young (2017) 1335sqft 4BR is good value on a PSF basis and the $1.749M ticket is liquid for D18 families. Strong Elo 1350 / 238-179 record. However no URA appreciation/median data exists (regional prior only), no MRT info is captured (Pasir Ris/Sea Horizon is not MRT-adjacent), and as a privatised EC the prestige ceiling is lower. Pasir Ris CRL interchange + town redevelopment are real D18 catalysts.

history.summary: Pasir Ris EC (built 2017) priced at $1,256 psf — the bottom of the project's own $1,212-1,573 range — in the OCR region that the backtest shows has the strongest realized forward return (+4.0%). The asking is genuinely cheap (-19.6% age-adj vs district) and the EC privatization in ~2027 is a concrete near-term catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,255.82 psf is at the floor of Sea Horizon's verified range ($1,212-1,573 psf, median project price $1.62M). The 'very_low_psf' flag is real but explained — this is an EC, which structurally trades below private condos until/after the 10-year privatization mark, due ~2027 from a 2017 completion; that privatization typically re-rates ECs upward as the full buyer pool opens. D18/OCR carries the best backtested forward prior (+4.0% vs CCR +0.7%). Rental ~$3.57 psf supports a ~3.4-3.5% gross yield. age_adj_premium -19.6% confirms it is cheap for its age. Confidence held at medium (not high) because appreciation is regional_baseline (0 txns), the unit is 1.1km from Pasir Ris MRT, and the EC has noted management/parking gripes.
red_flags: very_low_psf flag — partly structural (EC trades below private condos), not pure bargain
appreciation is regional_baseline with 0 project transactions — no project-specific forward signal
1.1km (~14 min) walk to Pasir Ris MRT, not within comfortable walking distance
resident reviews cite management/parking enforcement friction
catalysts: EC privatization ~2027 (10yr from 2017 TOP) opening the full resale buyer pool
Pasir Ris town rejuvenation / Pasir Ris Mall and Cross Island Line connectivity nearby
OCR region carries the strongest backtested forward return
